description: This file defines a Flutter widget called WinHighlightOverlay, which renders a visual overlay (a line) across the three winning tiles in a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It calculates positions based on grid layout constants and draws a line between the center points of the first and last indices in the winning sequence.

classes.name: WinHighlightOverlay
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that overlays a line across the winning tiles in the game grid.

classes.name: _WinLinePainter
classes.description: A CustomPainter responsible for drawing the line connecting the centers of the first and last winning tiles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the overlay, returning a CustomPaint widget with a painter that draws the winning line.

methods.name: _WinLinePainter
methods.description: Constructor initializing with the indices of the winning tiles.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Performs the actual drawing of the line on the canvas, calculating cell centers based on grid size and spacing.

methods.name: shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines if the painter should repaint when given new data; compares indices.
